name: zfmv_action_wait_update
description: zFMV_ActionWait::Update returns nonzero while the current script time is still before startSec + durationSec, and returns zero once the wait deadline has been reached.
known_limits: The smoke covers Update together with the paired wait Begin behavior; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x462ee0 validates a thiscall leaf method that adds the 32-bit float startSec and durationSec fields using x87, compares the double currentTimeSec argument against that deadline, returns 1 when currentTimeSec is less than the deadline, returns 0 otherwise, and pops the 8-byte argument.
The native smoke verifies the wait action remains active before startSec + durationSec and stops at the exact boundary after Begin establishes the start time.
